verdict: Numerical repair supported on the frozen 32 regression cases; original report and verifier contain errors and overclaims.

findings.issue: Hard-coded originally accepted cases [7,21,27] are wrong; source baseline cases are [7,14,19]. Verifier fails to derive this list from baseline.
Prediabetes endpoint does not exist. Remaining-case score values and endpoint labels do not match saved outputs. Use independent_review.json rows for recomputed values.

Claims model rescoring and per-case immutable-feature verification but only subtracts saved probabilities and compares saved nutrient vectors. Fresh review replays all 32 through frozen research model; this is new evidence.
Equations use legacy CVD cutoff 0.603 although repaired execution uses 0.5. Claims mathematically exact projection exceed numerical SLSQP evidence.

Projection emits passed=True and projected_successfully even if SLSQP does not converge; feasible LP fallback not separately labelled. Feasibility does not establish minimum-distance optimality. All 32 observed SLSQP runs report success; this is an untested failure-path weakness.

next_step: Correct report/verifier and solver-status handling, document scale provenance and target-change magnitude, then freeze implementation and reserve a new evaluation sample for rules-only/minimum-change/model-guided comparisons. Do not reclassify the 32 development cases as independent validation.
